desc: Tool output stays compact: claim_get lists healthy places without their wording once a claim has more than 8 places, and after a meaning change only the first 5 stale places are shown in full, the rest by file and id; each old meaning is printed once instead of on every place, and the end-of-turn check counts those places per claim instead of listing them again.
